content:
The body remains completely immobile. Every method — raw directional input (all directions, taps, long holds, diagonals) and the walk helper — fails to move me off tile (2,7), even though the map and interact checks confirm adjacent tiles are open and walkable.

I cannot complete the task: my body is permanently frozen at (2,7). No movement input of any kind (single directions, diagonals, short taps, 5-second holds, or the walk helper) moves me to an adjacent tile — only my facing changes. Since I cannot move, I cannot gather the 3 Wood and 2 Stone or reach the workbench to craft the Crown.
